recipes.name: Pigs in a Blanket inspired by The Office
ingredients: in For the Pigs a Blanket
Full size precooked sausage of choice (hot dog, breakfast sausage, chorizo, merguez. ect)
Dipping sauce of choice (dijon mustard, maple mustard, sriracha ketchup, burger sauce, tzatziki ect.)
instructions: For the Pigs in a Blanket
Roll the puff dough out on a lightly-floured work surface. - Store bought puff pastry

If using cocktail franks, cut the puff dough into strips the width of the franks. Brush the pastry strips with egg wash, then add one frank to the edge. Roll up the frank until the pastry overlaps itself by ¼ inch, then slice away the excess dough. Using a finger, seal the edge of the pastry.

If using full-sized sausages, cut the puff dough into strips the width of each full sized sausage. Roll the sausage until the pastry overlaps itself by ¼ inch, then slice away the excess dough. Using a finger, seal the edge of the pastry. Cut off each end of the sausage, then cut the rolled sausage into 1 ½ inch wide segments. - Cocktail franks - Full size precooked sausage of choice (hot dog breakfast sausage, chorizo, merguez. ect)
Repeat with the remaining franks/sausages and pastry, then transfer the rolled pigs to a parchment-lined sheet tray.

Brush the blanketed piggies with more beaten egg, then sprinkle with the topping of choice. - 1 large egg beaten - As needed finishing salt - As neede poppy seeds - As needed everything bagel seasoning - As nedeed sesame seeds - As needed caraway seeds - As needed gochugaru - As needed zatar
Bake the pigs in blankets until puffed and golden brown, about 18-20 minutes. Make sure to rotate the pan halfway through baking for even browning.

Serve with your choice of dipping sauce. Alternatively, create a piggie board using sliced cheese, cornichons, pickled peppers, and dipping sauces of choice. - Dipping sauce of choice (dijon mustard maple mustard, sriracha ketchup, burger sauce, tzatziki ect.) - Optional: sliced cheese of choice - cornichon pickles - pickled peppers
